grazing_equivalence.note: How much a grazing hectare counts against a cultivated one when measuring land use. Humid climates: meadow, hay and dairy land, worked as intensively as fields (0.5). Mediterranean, dry-summer and savanna: seasonal and transhumant grazing (0.3). Steppe, desert and the far north: open range (0.15). Explicit assumptions by displayed climate class; the HYDE pasture/rangeland split is not used because it is population-density based.

notes: Development means how intensively the land is already used for human purposes; at 100 the location is fully optimised for its current system.

land_use_share: used land (HYDE/LUH starting cultivation + grazing_equivalence x LUH grazing) as a share of the physical area, saturating at land_use_reference (30% used ~ 63 points of this component). feasible_utilisation: used land against the maximum feasible cultivation. improvement_share: ledger improvements over starting capacity. management_intensity: the management_intensity_kinds ledger per used hectare against the global p90.

Weights were chosen against the vanilla EU5 regional ordering (Spearman ~0.70 per location, ~0.90 by macro-region mean); this is a sanity reference, not a fitting target, and the map is never adjusted to close capacity gaps.

Ordering and spot-check bands are sanity constraints. Failing checks block the building assignment unless allow_failed_development_checks is set in configs/building_assignment.json, which must be reported.

2026-09-19: a served-irrigation component was tested (weights 0.15-0.25 on served/cultivated share) and rejected: it lowered the agreement with vanilla ordering and did not lift Cairo, whose location carries little served land in the model. P90 band set to 25-60 and maximum to 95 as the intended ranges; spot checks are reported but do not gate.

2026-09-19: grazing added. Before, cultivation alone scored wet and upland pasture economies (Holland, Frisia, Ireland, the Alps) as unused land, e.g. Alkmaar 4.2 with 40% grazing and 0.1% cropland in LUH 1300; the previous pasture component read a livelihood-type diagnostic that covers only steppe locations and had weight 0. Drainage and polder works now count as management per used hectare.

2026-09-20: development no longer multiplies capacity (capacity_percent_per_point 0). Population capacity flat is farmland; development enters only the building cap equations as a linear term. The derived formula stays available (source.kind = derived) as a diagnostic; the game starting development is the input.

2026-09-20: capacity_percent_per_point 0.01 = the EU5 engine's own development multiplier (1% per point, not scriptable away); development is the vanilla game-start value computed from the vanilla rules (data/raw/vanilla/start_development_1337.csv, range 0..~110).

2026-09-20: engine development multiplier observed in game as 2.5% per point (Zhigu: development 36 -> Population Capacity +90%); capacity_percent_per_point 0.025. Not a scriptable value; no define found.

2026-09-20: the development percentage is scriptable after all (vanilla static modifier development, +2.5% per point, in main_menu/common/static_modifiers/location.txt); the constructor replaces it without the capacity line, so capacity_percent_per_point is 0 again.

source.note: EU5 1.3.11 vanilla game-start development per location, the vanilla 14_development.txt rules evaluated on the vanilla location table by ppc worldbuilder export-development. Range 0..~110. Set kind to derived to use the land-use formula instead.
